Jana (eng-security): Heads up — getting a wave of session.revoked alerts from auth-monitor starting ~01:04 UTC. Users across eu-west-1 and us-east-1 reporting sudden logouts. Not seeing corresponding deploys. @Omar oncall?
Deploy-bot: okta-integration: mass session revoke detected: 312 accounts affected in 00:06. Alert severity: elevated.
Omar (oncall): I'm pulling the event stream now. Running quick counts.
Omar (oncall): query run: `SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM auth_events WHERE event='session.revoked' AND ts BETWEEN 1849203000 AND 1849203600 GROUP BY region;`
Omar (oncall): result: eu-west-1 198, us-east-1 94, ap-south-1 20. IPs look clustered: 54.37.128.0/24 and 3.8.12.0/24 seen in auth_attempts.
Maria (sre): No infra deploys on that window. No IAM policy changes in cloudtrail for admin principals.
Jana (eng-security): Good — check audit logs for any RBAC grants or service account escalations. Also check KMS key access logs for any unusual GetPublicKey / Decrypt calls.
Ricardo (infra): KMS logs show only expected key usage for normal services. No policy changes.
Omar (oncall): Okta support ticket opened (INC-18492) — asking for their session-revoke origin. Also rotated SSO session cookie validation to stricter mode temporarily.
Alex (product): Any customer-facing impact? Some users hit .login endpoints repeatedly; product metrics show spike in error 401 from some orgs.
Jana (eng-security): Minor user-facing logouts; recommend we send a short status note if this persists. Triage steps: 1) block offending IP CIDRs at WAF, 2) temporarily throttle session revocations from IdP, 3) force logout for service accounts created in last 24h (if any).
Maria (sre): I've pushed WAF block for 54.37.128.0/24 and 3.8.12.0/24. Also adding a quick rule to rate-limit /api/v1/sessions by origin header.
Omar (oncall): Running `curl -X GET "https://okta.example/tokens/active?from=01:00Z&to=01:10Z" -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'` and saving raw response to /tmp/okta-wave.json for analysis.
Deploy-bot: deploy pipeline blocked: cannot roll session code until security gives 👍.
Jana (eng-security): Evidence so far points to an automated client triggering SSO session invalidation en masse — likely credential stuffing or bot misusing signout endpoint. No sign of lateral access. Containment status: WAF blocks in place, IdP ticket open, no admin RBAC changes found.
Alex (product): I'll draft a short internal comm and a customer note template. Keep tone minimal: advising re-login and our investigation.
Ricardo (infra): Post-incident actions suggestion: add an alert for >200 session.revoked across regions in 10m, add a dedicated audit stream for SSO admin actions, and review KMS key rotation alerts.
Jana (eng-security): Agreed. I'll create an incident channel (#inc-18492-sso-wave) and start a short postmortem doc. Tagging CISO for awareness. If no further spike in 15m we'll downgrade, otherwise escalate to P1. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
